text:
Carmen: Quick follow-up from the runtime all-hands 1 - PMs need three things: (1) concise canary + roll timeline for kernel-v4, (2) what telemetry fields will be product-visible, (3) a single-sentence customer blurb about automatic fallback.

Evan: Canary window: 2025-11-02 -> 2025-11-09 for a small canary pool. Broader roll depends on signals; tentative mid-November.

Maya: Telemetry we'll expose: per-kernel latency histograms (p50/p95/p99), per-seq-length buckets, kv-cache hit/miss, per-node memory deltas, and an estimated cost-per-token metric. Product dashboard tile planned.

Priyanka: Customer blurb suggestion: "We stage kernel rollouts with canaries and automatic fallback to healthy variants; customers can pin kernels or opt-in to new behavior via Console or SDK flags." Use that in the roadmap.

Theo: Perf guidance for PMs: recommend microbatch=8-16 for interactive on 80G to keep median latency low; use batch>=64 for throughput. Note that v4 may allocate more transient KV on >1024 seq.

ops-bot: [alert] 2025-11-03T01:12 - Canary pool notice: transient elevated memory observed on a subset of 80G nodes; 9% traffic diverted to fallback variants.

Maya: Mitigation steps: reduce default batch_size to 16 for affected pools, divert heavy sessions to v3, and apply throttle to KV prefetch. Patch to reduce KV preallocation in flight; ETA 36h.

Evan: Action items recap: Maya publish telemetry endpoints + dashboard mock, Priyanka share the customer blurb in the roadmap doc, Theo prepare perf one-pager with batch/seq guidance. We'll reconvene at next eng sync.

Carmen: Thanks all 1 please drop links here when available. :white_check_mark:
